svg.title: API, MCP, and web viewer interface mesh
svg.desc: Stored records feed a shared service and read-model layer. REST serves initial and durable product reads, WebSocket serves viewer-safe live changes, and scoped MCP serves typed AI-host and producer tools. The web viewer and connected hosts use different delivery contracts without creating different game truth. Local simulation MCP remains separate and read-only.
